yogurt noun

also sour milk

modern

M-O

jogurtum, jogurtī n.

noun, second declension

The formerly printed initial ō was not supported by the checked source and is no longer asserted. The loanword’s stem quantities remain undetermined here; the genitive ending -ī is certain.

Other words

  • lac acidum — sour milk

    also used · classical · Plin. NH 28.135 (Lewis & Short s.v. acidus)

    Sour milk, in Pliny: a broader description.

  • * (our own formation) lac concrētum — thickened or coagulated milk

    also used · * our formation

    A description of consistency.

  • oxygala, oxygalae f. — ancient sour-milk preparation

    noun, first declension · also used · classical

    oxygala, oxygalactis n. is also attested. Historical preparations and modern yogurt need not be identical.

Examples

  • Jogurtum edis?

    Are you eating yogurt?composed

See also rennet, ferment, turn sour.
